name: scanbutler
description: Turns scanned paper into searchable PDFs, one per document, named by topic and date. The Stacks input splits large scans (hundreds of pages, no separator sheets) into documents by content. The Scanner input takes files from a document scanner, one document per file, and gives them the same OCR and naming. Uses Mistral OCR (batch API) and a Mistral chat model; the text layer comes from a fresh Tesseract pass. No web UI: progress is in the container log, and a review.md per stack in the Work folder lists uncertain splits. An optional third input only adds the text layer and uploads to Paperless-ngx. Optionally reports the queue to a webhook such as Home Assistant. Needs a Mistral API key.

paths.name: Stacks
paths.description: Large scans to split. inbox/, output/, archive/ and failed/ are created here.

paths.name: Scanner
paths.description: Scanner input, one document per file. Point the scanner's network-folder target at inbox/ below this path.

paths.name: Paperless
paths.description: Optional Paperless-ngx input (needs PAPERLESS_URL): files get the text layer and are uploaded to Paperless.

paths.name: Paperless 2
paths.description: Optional second Paperless input (needs PAPERLESS_2_TOKEN): uploads as another Paperless user, so its documents belong to that user.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Per-stack OCR text, plan.json, review.md and temporary page images (several GB while a large stack is processed). Holds full document text: delete stacks you no longer need.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User that owns new files (nobody)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group for new files (users)

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: 002: new files are writable for the users group, e.g. over SMB

variables.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
variables.description: Mistral API key

variables.name: MISTRAL_LLM_MODEL
variables.description: Model for splitting and naming

variables.name: MISTRAL_MAX_RPS
variables.description: Requests per second, slightly below your account's limit for MISTRAL_LLM_MODEL (Mistral console: API > Limits)

variables.name: TITLE_LANGUAGE
variables.description: Language for document titles, e.g. German. Empty: the language of each document.

variables.name: NO_DATE_LABEL
variables.description: Used in the file name when a document has no date

variables.name: OCRMYPDF_LANGUAGES
variables.description: Tesseract languages joined with +, e.g. deu+eng+fra. deu and eng are built in; others are downloaded once into the Config folder

variables.name: OCRMYPDF_JOBS
variables.description: Parallel OCR pages. auto: as many as the container's memory allows (--memory in Extra Parameters), at most one per CPU the container may use. Scanner and Paperless files go ahead of stacks

variables.name: PAPERLESS_URL
variables.description: Optional: Paperless-ngx base URL, e.g. http://NAS-IP:8000. Enables the Paperless input.

variables.name: PAPERLESS_TOKEN
variables.description: API token of the Paperless user that should own the uploaded documents

variables.name: PAPERLESS_TEXT_SOURCE
variables.description: tesseract: Paperless content from the text layer (free). mistral: content replaced with Mistral OCR text, tables kept (about $1 per 500 pages).

variables.name: PAPERLESS_TAGS
variables.description: Optional: comma-separated Paperless tag ids to add on upload, e.g. 3,7

variables.name: PAPERLESS_2_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional: API token of a second Paperless user. Enables the second input (Paperless 2 path); its uploads belong to that user

variables.name: PAPERLESS_2_URL
variables.description: Optional: Paperless URL for the second input. Empty: same as PAPERLESS_URL

variables.name: PAPERLESS_2_TAGS
variables.description: Optional: comma-separated tag ids to add on upload through the second input

variables.name: PAPERLESS_SHARE_TAGS
variables.description: true: remove the owner from every Paperless tag, every minute, so all users see the same tags. Needs a superuser token.

variables.name: PAPERLESS_SHARE_CORRESPONDENTS
variables.description: true: remove the owner from every Paperless correspondent, so all users see them (also who writes to whom). Needs a superuser token.

variables.name: PAPERLESS_SHARE_DOCUMENT_TYPES
variables.description: true: remove the owner from every Paperless document type, so all users see them. Needs a superuser token.

variables.name: PAPERLESS_SHARE_TAGS_READONLY
variables.description: Optional: comma-separated tag names that keep their owner and are only visible to other users, e.g. ai-processed

variables.name: QUEUE_WEBHOOK_URL
variables.description: Optional: POST queue counts here on every change and every 5 minutes, e.g. a Home Assistant webhook (http://HA:8123/api/webhook/ID). See the project README for the sensor config.

variables.name: STACKS_TEXT_SOURCE
variables.description: Text for splitting and naming stacks: mistral (Mistral OCR, paid) or tesseract (free, from the text layer)

variables.name: SCANNER_TEXT_SOURCE
variables.description: Text for naming scanner files: tesseract (free, from the text layer) or mistral (Mistral OCR, paid; worth it for handwriting or poor scans)

variables.name: OCR_MODE
variables.description: batch: half price, minutes per job. direct: immediate, full price.

variables.name: WORK_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Days after which a processed file's work folder in Config is deleted (rebuild works until then). 0 keeps everything

variables.name: FILENAME_PATTERN
variables.description: {title} is required, {date} is YYYY-MM-DD
